opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and postcode before discussing the order, and the caller gave both, so verification was done correctly.

understanding.quote: So you've disputed that payment with your bank and want to know the next step?
understanding.comment: You captured the caller's issue accurately and did not ask for information they had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Your bank will contact you with their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The statement about the bank contacting the caller is outside Tidewell's policy and was not verified; you should have stated only that the case is passed to the Payments team, who reply within 2 working days.

process_compliance.quote: I'll make a note on your order that you've opened a dispute. Your bank will contact you with their decision.
process_compliance.comment: For bank disputes the required step is to pass the case to the Payments team rather than just noting the order, and no handover to Payments was made.

communication.quote: Thank you for calling Tidewell, Mark. Take care.
communication.comment: The tone was polite throughout and the caller was not frustrated, so no acknowledgement of emotion was needed.

closing.quote: I'll email you today to confirm the note on your order. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely, which meets the closing standard.
